sentences.text: A UCB is prohibited from levying pre-payment charges in the situations covered by the in-force directions on pre-payment charges, including for floating-rate loans to individuals for non-business purposes and, for a Tier 3 UCB, business-purpose loans up to ₹50 lakh. [E11, E13]

The evidence provided does not state any monetary penalty that RBI imposes for levying prohibited foreclosure charges, and the searched rule findings address only whether pre-payment charges are permitted. [R1, R2, R3, R4]

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 para 261 and the related rule findings for any RBI monetary penalty for prohibited foreclosure/pre-payment charges.
